description: Schlock safety validation and session setup hooks. The PreToolUse/Bash command blocks (exit 2) unless the hook both exits 0 and prints the PreToolUse decision envelope as its whole stdout, so a hook that cannot start, or a python3 that exits without writing that envelope, blocks the tool call. stdout is passed through on every exit, so a block keeps its reason; see tests/test_hook_manifest.py

hooks.command: out=$(python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_tool_use.py"); rc=$?; case $out in '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "'*'}}') printf '%s\n' "$out"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 2 ;; *) echo 'schlock: pre_tool_use.py returned no decision' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
